name: bpgen-companion
title: bpgen companion (local)
author: mtopfox
description: The bpgen window (shortcut bar, Ctrl+Alt+B; with the fnative loader): pick a recipe, plan it in game, see the blueprint drawn by the game, put it in your hand. Hover an assembler and press Ctrl+Shift+B to plan a line for it. The snapshot tool (shortcut bar, Ctrl+Shift+N) sends an area of your base so bpgen can build next to it. Research and production per minute are written for bpgen on join, after research and every 5 minutes. Files go to script-output/bpgen/.
